annotations.title: Get a link to start or book

description: A link the person opens to start an on-demand call or book a scheduled one, prefilled with the language pair and/or interpreter. Payment is entered on Remoto's page (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal; guests need no account). This tool creates nothing and charges nothing.

duration_minutes.description: Scheduled only: booked length in minutes.

interpreter_id.description: Interpreter id: the number in the public profile URL (/profile/<id>), or the profile URL itself.

mode.description: on_demand = connect now; scheduled = book a time.

source.description: Source language: a name ("Farsi", "Brazilian Portuguese", "ASL") or code ("fas", "spa", "ase").

starts_at.description: Scheduled only: the chosen start time (ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. a bookable time's startsAt). With interpreter_id, source and target the link is a price-locked booking link.

target.description: Target language: a name ("Farsi", "Brazilian Portuguese", "ASL") or code ("fas", "spa", "ase").

name: get_start_link
